pearls.purpose: Biometric identity verification — tilt-to-capture liveness detection, document OCR, sanctions screening, and on-chain NFT attestation. Pass KYC once and receive a time-boxed attestation that every Melusina app can verify without accessing raw ID data.

offers.name: attestation-verify
offers.purpose: Verify a Merkle claim against the on-chain attestation root — individual claims (name, DOB, nationality, etc.) probeable without exposing the full KYC packet.

offers.name: attestation-status
offers.purpose: Check if a wallet holds a valid (non-expired, non-revoked) attestation NFT.

offers.name: kyc-complete-hook
offers.purpose: Notify subscribing grains when a KYC attestation is issued or revoked — enables reactive account opening, tier upgrade, etc.

requests.name: admin-gate
requests.purpose: Obtain admin capability from ccash admin grain for correspondent account creation and DueProcess case routing.

requests.name: config-gate
requests.purpose: Obtain config capability from cyberteller config grain for payment slip workflow integration.

fields: Merkle leaf salts (never leave the grain)

adminOnly.name: Issue attestation
adminOnly.purpose: Approve KYC packet and mint the on-chain NFT attestation. Requires Owner role + OTP-gated.

adminOnly.name: Revoke attestation
adminOnly.purpose: Freeze or revoke an existing attestation. Requires Owner role + OTP-gated.

adminOnly.name: Configure attestation policy
adminOnly.purpose: Set attestation expiry duration (90/180/365 days), trusted jurisdiction list, and Merkle claim schema.

anyMember.name: Start KYC process
anyMember.purpose: Begin the identity verification flow — upload ID documents, capture biometrics, fill questionnaire.

anyMember.name: View own attestation status
anyMember.purpose: Check the status and expiry of your own attestation.

anyMember.name: Selective disclosure
anyMember.purpose: Authorize individual claim probes by other grains.

requires.purpose: Correspondent account creation on Fineract + DueProcess case routing

grants.purpose: Merkle claim verification via NamedCoin-sidecar HMAC-signed probe

blockchains.purpose: Each attestation mints an NFT on Solana devnet. Merkle root stored on-chain; individual claims verified via selective-disclosure probe.

httpOut.purpose: All egress goes through the NamedCoin-sidecar — HMAC-signed requests to ailagoon (LLM), OpenSanctions (screening), and mermail (email/OTP).

tabs.title: Biometric Capture
tabs.description: Tilt-to-capture liveness detection, selfie, and document photo

tabs.title: Process Status
tabs.description: KYC verification status and attestation details

tabs.title: Result
tabs.description: Attestation result and Merkle claim summary

exports.purpose: Allows DueProcess to execute review procedures (kyc-refresh, sanctions-recheck, account-open, payment-block) on behalf of the NamedCoin grain.

imports.purpose: Required for correspondent account creation and DueProcess case routing.

sidecarAccess.label: NamedCoin-sidecar
sidecarAccess.purpose: KYC signing, Merkle probe/disclose, NFT mint/verify, biometric sign, contact OTP

sidecarAccess.label: OpenSanctions-sidecar
sidecarAccess.purpose: Sanctions screening against OFAC, UN, EU, UK, CH lists

sidecarAccess.label: mermail-sidecar
sidecarAccess.purpose: Email and phone OTP delivery for contact verification
